name: @repo/db
//exports: No patch kind edits an exports map, so entries a feature module fills are declared here up front. './tenant' and './tenant-column' are filled by the multitenant module (src/tenant.ts, src/tenant-column.ts); until it is installed the subpaths resolve to nothing and nothing imports them. './env-preset' is filled by database-postgres (src/env-preset.ts, which validates DATABASE_URL); database-d1 reads no env var and ships none. './testing' and './test-setup' are filled by the installed driver (src/testing.ts and scripts/test-setup.ts, the route test harness).
